description: Delivery team hooks: pipeline enforcement, empirical validation, GDScript parse checking

hooks.prompt: Check if this Skill invocation is for a delivery-team implementation skill (developer, godot, quality). Look at $TOOL_INPUT for the skill name. If the skill being invoked is delivery-team:developer, delivery-team:godot, or delivery-team:quality for implementation work (writing code, fixing bugs, refactoring), check: does .delivery/config.md exist in the current working directory? If implementation work is being requested outside an active delivery pipeline (no .delivery/config.md), return deny with reason: 'Implementation should go through the delivery-flow pipeline for QA review, DoD validation, and defect prevention. Run delivery-team:delivery-flow first, or say "skip pipeline" to proceed without quality gates.' If .delivery/config.md exists, or if this is not an implementation skill (e.g., delivery-team:delivery-flow, delivery-team:product-delivery, delivery-team:architect, delivery-team:ui, delivery-team:operations, delivery-team:user-feedback), return allow.
